summary: Builds a linked list of filter-property entries on `this`. Iterates the global filter-property table (dword_8AC488 entries, 396-byte stride, property name copied from the aFilterProperti pool at v12 + dword_8AC490 + 260). Skips keys already present via LinkedListKeySearch and entries whose copied name matches no element of the selection array a2 (sub_566810). For each selected entry, allocates a 16-byte node initialized with key v4 and the name via sub_4C5C80, wraps it in a 12-byte list element (element[0] = node, element[4] = next, element[8] = 1), and appends it to the list anchored at this+0x8 (head) / this+0xC (tail), incrementing the count at this+0x14. Returns the number of appended items; 0 when any guard fails.

operations.description: Require *a2 non-zero (valid selection array) and a3 > 0 (selection length) before building.
Read the global filter-property count dword_8AC488 as the loop bound v13.
Iterate property index v4 from 0 while v4 < dword_8AC488, advancing the pool offset v12 by 396 bytes each iteration.
Skip the property when LinkedListKeySearch(this, v4) reports key v4 already present in the list.
Skip the entry when the computed pool offset v12 + dword_8AC490 is zero.
Initialize the local 256-byte name buffer: seed first byte from byte_5EA438, zero the remainder.
Copy the property name from the aFilterProperti string pool at v12 + dword_8AC490 + 260 into the buffer via StringCopyWithValidation; on failure skip the entry.
Scan the selection array a2 (length a3) for an element that sub_566810 matches against the copied name; skip the entry when no element matches.
Allocate a 16-byte node with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and initialize it via sub_4C5C80(node, v4, name_buffer).
Allocate a 12-byte list element: element[0] = node pointer, element[4] = 0 (next), element[8] = 1.

Append the element to this list: when head this+0x8 is null, set head = element and this+0x10 = element; otherwise set tail this+0xC -> next (element offset +4) = element. Always set tail = element and increment the count at this+0x14.
Return the number of appended items (v11); return 0 when any guard fails.

clean_pseudocode: if (no element of a2 matches name) continue;
